purpose: The model a run actually used, as a record with a source and a confidence, bound into the profile digest so that runs under different models never form one cohort.

fields.provider: string|null. The provider the model belongs to: from an explicit `provider/` prefix, from the runtime event, or from the adapter's declared provider. Null when nothing named one.
fields.family: string|null. The leading alphabetic run of the model name (`gpt`, `claude`). Descriptive only; never used for comparison.
fields.id: string|null. `provider/model` when the provider is known, else the model name alone. Null when the model is unknown or when detected and declared disagree.
fields.source: runtime-event | runtime-config | declared | unknown. The highest-precedence source that named the model.
fields.confidence: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW | NONE. Fixed by source: runtime-event HIGH, runtime-config MEDIUM, declared LOW, unknown NONE.
fields.evidence_digest: sha256:<hex>|null. Digest over the bytes of the canonical claim that produced the record (source, provider, id, runtime, row digest). Null when unknown.
fields.mutable_alias: true | false | null. True for `latest`, `default`, `gpt`, `sonnet` and every provider-managed name without a snapshot marker; false for an exact snapshot; null when no model was identified.

mismatch: When two present sources name different models the record has status MISMATCH, id null, source unknown, confidence NONE and `mismatch: { code: "AOS_MODEL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", detected, declared }`. It is never resolved to either side.

alias_policy.exact_snapshot_marker: a YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD segment delimited by `-`, `_`, `.`, `:`, `@` or the ends of the name
